# Hand-marked harmony in Mozart, Piano Sonata in C major, K. 545 ("Sonata facile"), first movement, in the chord syntax of the cadences files.
#
# SOURCE: Michelle's review of 2026-11-07 (analyzer-review, R-357, R-365).
# STATUS: VERIFIED by Michelle Opitz, 2026-11-07. It covers stretches of the piece, not all of it: chords outside a
# stretch (a first chord line to its end line) are not read. tests/analysis/test_reference_harmony.c reports the
# chain's chords against it (report only until P39).
#
# FORMAT, one per line (lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored):
#   meter <beats per measure> <beat length as a fraction of a whole note>
#   home <tonic>              the piece's key (major): C Db D Eb E F F# G Ab A Bb B
#   chord <measure> <beat> <tonic> <numeral>   a chord, in the major key on <tonic>, sounding until the next chord line
#                             (or the end line); beats are 1-based; numerals are ASCII: V7, vi, viio7/V (an applied
#                             chord is a slash and the degree it tonicizes)
#   end <measure> <beat>      the end of the stretch of chords
#
meter 4 1/4
home C
chord 1 1 C I
chord 2 1 C V
chord 2 3 C I
chord 3 1 C IV
chord 3 3 C I
chord 4 1 C V
chord 4 3 C I
chord 5 1 C IV
chord 6 1 C I
end 7 1
chord 8 1 C vi
chord 9 1 C ii
chord 10 1 C IV
chord 11 1 C V
chord 11 2 C I
chord 11 3 C V
chord 11 4 C I
chord 12 1 C V
end 13 1
